tutorial.0: Welcome, commander! Tap one of your soldiers, or press Select all, to choose your units.

tutorial.3: Gather your army and destroy the enemy headquarters in the far corner of the map.

armory.title: Armory

campaign.title: Campaign
mission.1.name: Outpost Alpha
mission.1.brief: Scouts report a lightly held enemy outpost. Train riflemen at your barracks, gather your squad and destroy the enemy headquarters. Tap a building to see what it can build.
mission.2.name: Supply Lines
mission.2.brief: Command wants a stronger economy before the next push. Build two supply centers and grow your army to 12 units. No enemy is nearby, so take your time.
mission.3.name: Hold the Line
mission.3.brief: Enemy raiding parties are coming for your base. Keep your headquarters standing for five minutes. Train troops and keep them close to home.
mission.4.name: First Skirmish
mission.4.brief: A real enemy commander has set up camp across the map. Their headquarters is damaged, but they will build up fast. Strike before they do.
mission.5.name: Iron Fist
mission.5.brief: An enemy stronghold blocks the way. Your vehicle factory can build jeeps and tanks that shrug off rifle fire. Destroy every enemy building.
mission.6.name: Canyon Run
mission.6.brief: The only way across the map is a narrow canyon. Hold out while enemy jeeps and rifle squads probe your defences, and destroy twenty enemy units.
mission.7.name: Even Odds
mission.7.brief: Your opponent is a capable commander and starts with the same forces as you. Out-build them, then destroy their headquarters.
mission.8.name: The Fortress
mission.8.brief: Walls and towers guard the enemy base. Upgrade your base for stronger units, break through the defences and destroy their headquarters.
mission.9.name: Last Stand
mission.9.brief: A massive assault is coming. You have a strong base, a stockpile of resources and two tanks. Survive eight minutes.
mission.10.name: Final Offensive
mission.10.brief: A veteran commander, a full base and no advantages for you. Win this match and the war is yours.
